title: Evolve product knowledge without losing history
statement: As a change author, I can revise and reconcile product knowledge as understanding changes, so that the current intent stays clear without erasing earlier decisions.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Revising a story preserves every earlier revision.
Concurrent story revisions remain visible until an author reconciles them.
Moving a story to another product domain preserves its links.
An author can propose, accept, defer, reject, or retire a story.
A retired story remains available in its history.
Rewording an unchanged obligation preserves its criterion identity.
A story can identify the source of its requirement.
